Before this change, non-automatic groups returned every member and automatic groups returned up to 200. Now every request defaults to `limit=50`. The public `group-members` route calls `model.findMembers()` with the model's default limit of 50, and `group/members.hbs` has no next/previous controls. app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:24 - create/update now read top-level params, which breaks existing API clients that send `group[...]`.. Before, `create` and `update` read `params[:group][:name]`, `params[:group][:visible]`, and so on. Now they read `params[:name]` and `params[:visible]` directly. An API client still sending the old nested shape gets a blank name on create, which fails validation. On update, its fields are ignored and `visible` is silently reset to false, because `params[:visible] == "true"` is now false. The `group[usernames]` and PATCH `changes` membership APIs are also removed with no replacement path for those clients. If external callers exist, accept both shapes or document the break.

app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 - limit and offset are not validated, so negative or zero values reach SQL.. `params[:limit].to_i` and `params[:offset].to_i` are passed directly to `.limit`/`.offset`. A request with `offset=-1` or `limit=-5` makes PostgreSQL raise an error ("OFFSET must not be negative"), which returns a 500. A very large `limit` also lets any viewer pull the whole member list in one request. Clamp both values, for example `limit = [[limit, 1].max, 200].min` and `offset = [offset, 0].max`.
